name: MiseOS Repository Reliability Kit
description: Repository reliability templates, issue templates, Dependabot configuration, CI starters, incident docs, and release checklists for MiseOS repositories.

changePolicy.major: Human review required for policy defaults, workflow permissions, or branch protection expectations.
changePolicy.minor: Allowed for new templates and checklists.
changePolicy.patch: Allowed for wording, docs, and minor workflow fixes.

release.currentStrategy: Apply through pull requests and keep CI workflows advisory until reviewed.

answers.what: A repository reliability and governance starter kit.
answers.does: Adds issue templates, PR templates, security docs, incident docs, CI starters, and Dependabot configuration.
answers.permissions: Advisory file changes only through reviewed pull requests.
answers.changed: Integrated uploaded reliability kit into root templates, docs, and workflows.
answers.safe: Safe when applied through PR review; workflow permission changes are human-gated.
answers.agentExecutable: Agents may recommend or stage changes, but human review is required before writes.
